title: Sweden pauses Denmark power cable over EU grid rules
summary: Sweden has suspended the power cable connection to Denmark due to EU electricity grid regulatory compliance concerns, creating a dispute between the two Nordic nations over energy infrastructure rules.
problem_solved: This is a news report about an energy dispute, not a technical solution—Sweden is raising concerns about Denmark's compliance with EU electricity market regulations.
why_valuable: It highlights the growing tension between national energy policies and EU-wide grid regulations in the European energy transition.
